admissionHelp: Only source addresses holding a valid grant of the selected knock rule can reach this site. Grants come from port knocking packets or from logging in on a release entry. Admission only decides who can connect; the site's and the app's own logins still apply, so other people behind the same public IP can connect but still have to log in.
denyCloseTip: Consider setting the deny action below to Close connection so visitors and scanners that are not allowed cannot see this site at all.
lanHelp: Private and link-local addresses are let through directly (loopback excluded). Leave this off when traffic arrives through frp, a tunnel or another forwarder without the real client IP, because every visitor then looks like a LAN address.
grantHelp: After a visitor passes this site's authentication, Gately grants the selected knock rule to their source IP, so sites, port forwards and other entries that require this rule let that IP in. LAN and local addresses are never released.
sameRule: A release entry cannot require admission by the same rule, otherwise visitors who are not released yet cannot log in
v6PrefixHelp: IPv6 visitors are released by network, /64 by default, which covers temporary address rotation on the same device. Use 128 to release a single address.
probeV4Ph: Domain with only an A record (optional)
probeV6Ph: Domain with only an AAAA record (optional)
probeHelp: Phones often log in over IPv6 while the app connects over IPv4. With one IPv4-only and one IPv6-only domain of this site, the release page visits each once to release the other address family too. Both domains must be added to this site and covered by its certificate.
entryNoHost: This site has no directly reachable domain
entryHelp: After logging in, visitors can open this page to see the released addresses and their expiry, or revoke them. Visiting any authenticated page of this site also releases and renews automatically.
